title: cross-sdk retry-observability and resumable-stream snapshots (ergonomics bump)
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds cross-SDK retry inspector for observability; introduces session snapshot checkpoints for resumable streaming; minor API ergonomics and version bumps for py/ts/go; compatibility shim for legacy token providers.
description: Motivation: customers and internal teams reported opaque retry behavior in streaming SDKs and duplicated token refreshes under high load. This PR introduces a cross-language (Python/TypeScript/Go) retry-inspector hook for low-cardinality telemetry and a session-snapshot checkpoint primitive that lets generator/pull-stream consumers resume after auth refresh or transient failures. Key changes: 1) retry-inspector API and default emitter (py/ts/go) that emits sampled retry lifecycle events and tags (opt-in sampling, low-cardinality flag documented); 2) session-snapshot checkpoints for async generators/iterables and pull-stream adapters with a simple serialization proto and pluggable persistence (file/memory/kv); 3) legacy token callback compat adapter that maps old providers to the new credential profile shape; 4) deprecation notes and migration helpers for callback-based streaming surfaces, with code examples; 5) minor ergonomic tweaks to stream constructors and backpressure hints; 6) package version bumps (python 2.5.0, typescript 1.28.0, go 1.9.0) and changelog updates; 7) integration tests and docs examples. Backwards compatibility: provided via the compat adapter; default behavior unchanged unless the retry-inspector or snapshot persistence is enabled. Checklist: - Implement retry-inspector hooks and samplers in py/ts/go; - Add session snapshot serialization + persistence adapters; - Provide legacy token provider shim; - Add unit and integration tests (resume, retry telemetry); - Update docs and changelogs; - Add CI harness knobs for memory-backed snapshot store. Planned follow-ups: expand Dedicated deployment examples and add alerting rules for retry flux.
